functionDeclarations.name: manage_subagents
functionDeclarations.description: Manage the direct subagents of this conversation. 'list' reports each one's conversationId (the id used to kill or message it) and live state. Killing a subagent also kills its descendants and deletes their branched workspaces; logs and artifacts are preserved.

Action.description: 'kill' terminates the subagents named in ConversationIds; 'kill_all' terminates all.
